demo.text: You've put AI agents on Kubernetes. They can read logs, check rollouts, and find the cause.
But they only work when someone opens a prompt and asks.
Alerts and questions land in team chat. Putting your agent there is another project.
Introducing Agent Kourier: a Kubernetes-native broker between team chat and A2A agents.
An alert, or a question, becomes an agent session, in the thread where it landed. Slack today.
Your alerting posts to the channel as it always has. Agent Kourier reads the post and hands it to your agent, which investigates in the alert's thread, step by step.
Reply in the thread, and the same session continues. Same context, nothing re-explained.
Or skip the alert, and just ask.
When the agent needs a decision, it asks, and waits for your answer.
A team applies a Binding next to its agent. The agent needs no chat code.

It works with kagent, or any A2A agent that streams. Agent Kourier keeps the thread, streams the reply, and carries the agent's questions and your answers. Slack today; more chat platforms are planned. Agent Kourier. Write the agent, not the chat integration.
